title: Tim Hortons Ropewalk Lane counter heights and reviewed renovation drawings
code_edition: Buildings Accessibility Regulations, section 33; edition not stated

facts.text: The appeal concerns Inspector Order 20549 about lowering public service counters at a restaurant at 30 Ropewalk Lane.
The decision summary quotes a 865 mm maximum height for a barrier-free counter section under section 33 of the Buildings Accessibility Regulations.
The appellant said renovation drawings had been reviewed and a permit issued; the summary says the tribunal treated those drawings/permit as relevant, but the drawings are not attached.
